subject: SIG/CAIQ submission: request for IRP summary + sanitized telemetry and retention clarification
messages:
From: Alice Chen <security@novacorp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Novacorp Compliance Team <compliance@novacorp.com>
Date: 2028-09-27T08:12:00-04:00
Subject: SIG/CAIQ: request for IRP summary + sanitized telemetry and retention clarification

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking our SIG intake last week — we appreciated the walkthrough. The SOC 2 SIG reviewer on our side requested two follow-ups before we close the questionnaire:

1) A 1–2 page summary of your Incident Response Plan (IRP) that highlights escalation paths, retention/forensics steps, and SLA commitments for customer-impacting incidents.
2) A sanitized telemetry extract for the window 2028-09-01 through 2028-09-15 that demonstrates alerting and containment events for host and API auth anomalies. We need the telemetry to be redacted of PII and customer identifiers.

Can you confirm:
- Who will be the point of contact for the artifact transfer and redaction questions?
- The redaction approach (hashed IDs vs. token replacement) you plan to use and whether you can provide a manifest describing fields removed/obfuscated.
- How long Redwood retains the shared artifacts on your side once the reviewer has completed their validation (we typically ask for max 90 days unless otherwise negotiated).

For our tracker I attached the SIG template and marked the two outstanding cells. If it's helpful, we can open a shared Drive folder and a short WebEx to walk through the artifact once available.

Appreciate a quick confirmation of timelines — our reviewer is aiming to close this by Oct 6.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Senior Security Analyst
Novacorp
Attachment: Novacorp_SIG_Template.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <security@novacorp.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-27T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ: request for IRP summary + sanitized telemetry and retention clarification

Alice — thanks for the clear note and the template. We'll own this. Quick answers up front and an internal plan: 

- Point of contact: Jonas Weber (jonas_weber@redwood.com) will coordinate artifact prep and transfer. Marissa will assist with redaction validation; Ben will confirm KMS/keys for any signed manifest.
- Redaction approach: we plan to provide hashed customer IDs (SHA-256 salt) and zero out any IPs when they are not required for the reviewer’s checks. We'll include a redaction_manifest.csv that enumerates fields removed/obfuscated and the hashing salt method (not the salt itself).
- Retention: Redwood retains reviewer-submitted artifacts in a temporary secure share for up to 60 days by default; we can extend to 90 days on request (we'll note this in the export package and in the Drive link metadata).

Planned timeline: prep & redaction complete by 2028-09-28 EOD PT, transfer and invite to shared Drive on 2028-09-29, and stand-up review WebEx on 2028-09-30 if that works for Novacorp. If Oct 6 is the hard deadline, we can accelerate the WebEx earlier.

Jonas — can you confirm the export (telemetry_20280901-20280915) will be ready and list the files we expect to attach? Also flag anything that may need legal review.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-28T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ: request for IRP summary + sanitized telemetry and retention clarification

Kimberly — confirming artifacts and redaction approach. Summary of deliverables we will upload to the shared Drive folder: 

- telemetry_20280901-20280915_sanitized.zip (contains API auth events, alert timeline, containment markers; all customer identifiers hashed; IP addresses zeroed where not needed).
- IRP_summary_v2.pdf (2 pages: escalation ladder, timelines for detection->containment->remediation, SLA commitments for service-impact incidents).
- redaction_manifest.csv (columns: original_field, redaction_type, reason, sample_transformation_description).

Note on process: the redaction job is automated against our sanitized pipeline; Marissa will run a sampling verification (10% sample) to validate no PII remains. Ben — please confirm the signed manifest workflow (we sign the manifest with our KMS key id: rw-kms-43) so Novacorp can verify integrity.

Estimated completion: All artifacts packaged and uploaded by 2028-09-29 09:00 PT. I'll send the Drive link and a notes doc when live. Legal review flagged: the manifest content is fine, legal confirmed the hashing approach as acceptable for third-party reviewers (no need for additional NDAs beyond the existing MSA).

-Jonas
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment references: telemetry_20280901-20280915_sanitized.zip, IRP_summary_v2.pdf, redaction_manifest.csv

Date: 2028-09-29T16:42:00-04:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ: request for IRP summary + sanitized telemetry and retention clarification

Kimberly/Jonas/Team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clarity here. Confirming receipt of the Drive share this afternoon and the artifacts: telemetry_20280901-20280915_sanitized.zip, IRP_summary_v2.pdf, and the redaction_manifest.csv.

A couple of clarifications from our reviewer after a quick pass: 
- The manifest format looks good; can you add one example row (sanitized) to the CSV so we can see transformation pattern without revealing raw data?
- For retention: 60 days is acceptable for our reviewers, but we will request a copy to remain in our secure audit folder for up to 90 days. If Redwood prefers to expire at 60 days, Novacorp will take a local copy and confirm deletion from the Redwood share at 60 days. Please state which process you prefer so we can mark it on our tracker.

We have a short slot available for a WebEx on 2028-10-01 11:00 ET to do a walkthrough and confirm closure. If that works, we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks again — we're close to closing the SIG questions.

Best,
Alice Chen
Senior Security Analyst
Novacorp
